scope: WASM SUBSTRATE only — availability, SIMD, threads, and a fixed integer kernel. NOT ONNX Runtime Web, NOT a model. S-03 remains a separate, untested question.

machine_boundary.windows_host: HP OMEN 16-ap0xxx — workstation 2. Host only; no Windows browser involved.

kernel.why: deliberately identical to the S-02a WebGPU probe so the two are comparable on one machine and one browser
kernel.built_from: kernel.wat / kernel-simd.wat, compiled with wabt, embedded as base64 so the probe needs no fetch

variants.wasm-unsafe-eval-headful: manifest declares script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self' — measured to establish that a remedy EXISTS. Not adopted anywhere.

gpu_state.note: Irrelevant to this experiment — WASM needs no GPU. Recorded for continuity: nvidia-smi works (CUDA compute), /dev/dri absent, 0 Vulkan ICDs, OpenGL is llvmpipe.

system_changes.why: compile kernel.wat to kernel.wasm; the WAT source is committed so the binary is reproducible

data.profiles: fresh temporary Firefox profile per run, deleted afterwards
